data.name: Dhikra
data.gender_notes: Dhikra is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: It is derived from the Arabic word 'dhikr' which means 'remembrance'. It is used to remember Allah and his blessings. The name Dhikra carries the meaning “Remembrance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Dhikra usually hope their child will grow to embody remembrance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Remembrance of Allah is the essence of faith.
data.etymology: Dhikra belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Remembrance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhikra total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: ذِكرى
in_arabic.long_meaning: ذِكرى المَقتولين وَالأحيا، مِنَ أَسماء الحُسنا، ذِكرى المَقتولين وَالأحيا، وَهيَ أَن يُذَكِّر الحَداثَينَ مِنَ المَقتولين وَالأحيا، بِذِكر المَواقِعِ المُقَتَّلة، وَالأَحيا، وَهيَ مِنَ الأَسماءِ الَّتي جُعِلَت عَلى أَسماءِ النَبيينَ

in_urdu.name: ذِکراء
in_urdu.long_meaning: ذِکراءٔ المَقتلین اور زندہ، ایک نیک نام ہے، ذِکراءٔ المَقتلین اور زندہ، یہ نام ان لوگوں کی یاد میں ہے جو قتل ہوچکے ہیں اور زندہ ہیں، یہ نام اسی سے ملتا ہے جیسا کہ نبیوں کے ناموں میں ہے

in_hindi.name: धिक्रा
in_hindi.long_meaning: धिक्रा मृत्यु और जीवन की, एक अच्छा नाम है, धिक्रा मृत्यु और जीवन की, यह नाम वे लोगों की याद में है जो मृत्यु हो चुके हैं और जिन्हें जीवन है, यह नाम इसी से मिलता है जैसा कि नबियों के नामों में है

in_pashto.name: ذِکراء
in_pashto.long_meaning: ذِکراء د دښتونو او ژوندیو، یوړه لوی نوم دی، ذِکراء د دښتونو او ژوندیو، هغه د دښتونو او ژوندیو یاد کول، د دښتونو یادولو او هغه ژوندیو یاد کونو، دا یوړه د نبیانو نومونو په پرتله دی

in_english.name: Dhikra
in_english.meaning: Remembrance of the slain and the living
in_english.long_meaning: Dhikra is the remembrance of the slain and the living, a name that conveys goodness, it refers to the remembrance of the past events that led to death and the living, it is a name that is associated with the names of the prophets

trends: The term is used in contemporary Islamic literature to refer to the act of remembering Allah.
